创作3:4竖版梦幻实验海报，天空蓝上部、玫瑰粉中部、薄荷绿底部，以喷枪柔染自然融接，表面覆盖细密半色调与细颗粒。顶部巨大的白色高对比斜体衬线标题“moon moth”，字形修长、轻柔发光。中央是一只巨大月蛾，身体从左下向右上倾斜，四片长而卷曲的翅膀展开：右上翼高高伸入标题下沿，左翼横向延展，下翼形成优雅长尾并向左下弯曲。主体使用乳白、浅粉与淡紫的半透明X射线效果，精细翼脉和内部纤维透过薄翼可见，柔和过曝白光勾勒外轮廓。月蛾身后有一个巨大透明椭圆玻璃环，轻薄重叠弧线围住主体。画面主体占中部约三分之二，保持飞翔的倾斜动势。底部一行三组白色斜体衬线标签“(Soft wings)”“(Quiet orbit)”“(Color drift)”，下方三行居中白色衬线文字“Pale wings gather the wandering light, / carrying quiet colors through the air, / until the night begins to bloom.” 喷枪、晕染、半色调和X射线辉光融合，柔软明亮、印刷质感。无马、无独角兽、无爱心框、无第三方标记、无水印。

创作3:4竖版梦幻实验平面海报。背景为喷枪与湿染形成的连续色域：左下明亮青蓝和薄荷绿，中央柔粉，右侧珊瑚红，带细密半色调和均匀纸张颗粒。顶部四分之一用白色大小不一的圆点排出巨大细长大写“TIDE”，点阵疏密自然变化。上三分之一处一条纤细横向珊瑚枝从左到右贯穿画面，带精细多孔结构，透明冰蓝浅紫X射线材质，边缘过曝白光。中央悬挂一枚长螺旋海螺，顶部小环连接珊瑚，螺壳沿垂直轴向下延伸至画面四分之三处，内部螺旋腔体清晰但柔和，白色辉光包裹。中下部左右分别排列三行带下划线的白色无衬线文字，左侧“CORAL TRACES / MOVING IN COLOR / HELD BY LIGHT”，右侧“SPIRAL FORMS / LAYERED IN SILENCE / SHAPED BY TIDES”。底部用白色圆点构成大幅连笔花体“Undercurrent”，最底部小字“COLOR STUDY”。保留中心垂挂和横向贯穿的十字骨架，强烈柔焦、晕染与透明结构并存。无钥匙、无蕾丝、无第三方账号、无水印。

宝丽来框内
在宝丽来相框内填充一幅鲜艳的电影感旅行场景，瞬间传达 [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] 的特质。自动将其最具辨识度的地标、建筑、风景、地方美食、交通工具、传统手工艺、街头气息与自然风光，以及日常文化细节，融合为一个统一协调的环境。

相框外
打造一个以目的地视觉识别为灵感的高级柔和渐变背景。在宝丽来相框四周点缀优雅的单色手绘旅行插画与小型图形图标，代表有意义的地标、地方美食、动植物、交通工具、地图、传统纹样、建筑与文化细节。

在底部加入一句简短优雅的旅行标语，并以一句简短的励志旅行手写短语点缀。字体保持精致、极简，并与整体构图融为一体。

高级可收藏旅游海报 × 精致 3D 插画 × 真实微缩立体感 × 当代编辑设计 × 俏皮角色讲故事。

使用柔和的电影感光影、真实材质、细腻的景深、触感肌理、立体阴影、鲜明但雅致的受目的地启发的色彩，以及精致的高印刷品质感细节。

[Reference roles]
@image1 = identity only for 8 zombies, one each: tall thin hoodie man, short stocky worker man, tall office woman, apron housewife, hunched old man, short old woman, male student, girl in sportswear. Same character across front/side/back views. Keep gray dead skin, cloudy eyes, dirty modern clothing. Ignore gray background, labels, turnaround layout.
@image2 = only adult heroine identity and costume: black hair in high bun, gold floral crown with hanging beads and white flowers, ivory and pale-cyan layered long dress, translucent embroidered wide sleeves, gold floral waist ornament. Lock face, makeup, proportions, hairstyle, fabric structure. She is always empty-handed.
@image3 = only location: abandoned gas station, canopy pillars, fuel pumps, convenience store behind, road and old GAS sign on the left, wet cracked concrete, puddles, mountain forest, cloudy moonlit night. Keep all landmarks and equipment positions fixed. Keep original physical signage. Ignore collage borders and explanatory text.

[Space lock]
World orientation never flips: convenience store behind, open forecourt ahead, road and GAS sign on the left. Heroine starts in the passage between the two front fuel pumps near the canopy front edge, facing the open forecourt. All close combat stays inside this passage within about 2 meters. From 5.00s to 8.80s she is pressured backward exactly two steps toward the store, about 1 meter total: left foot back first, then right foot back, ending left foot forward, right foot back. She never goes behind the pumps. Dress wraps around the pump bases naturally, feet fully land on the ground.
Tall thin zombie attacks from front-left and gets knocked into the left-front pillar, then braces on it and re-enters from beside the pillar. Worker zombie attacks repeatedly from center front and must plant, turn back, and re-enter after each deflection or setback. Office woman attacks from left-front and is knocked back to outer left-front. Sportswear girl circles around the outside edge of the left pump and enters from left-front only after passing the front end of the machine, never through it. Housewife, old man, old woman, and male student fill from the deeper front layer in staggered timing. Fallen zombies stay where they land, no reset.
Camera stays on the heroine’s right-side half-space, using the line between heroine and worker zombie as the main combat axis. Usual framing: heroine left of frame, front zombie group right of frame. The overhead angle remains under the canopy, never above the roof.

[Look and light]
Cold blue-gray moonlit night with old-gold magic. Palette: deep midnight blue-black #14212D, cold gray-cyan #71838A, ivory #E8E1D2, pale jade #B8C8BC, aged gold #C5A05A. Natural warm skin for heroine around #D0AD97, zombies remain dead gray. Low saturation, medium-high contrast, rich readable shadows, soft highlight rolloff, light film grain. Preserve skin, wet fabric, embroidery, rusted metal, puddle texture. Main cool moonlight from upper left, weak 4000K canopy lamp, faint warm store glow. White balance and exposure stay stable across all shots. Gold petals add only local warm reflections on face edge, hands, sleeves, puddles, fading with distance. Night mood always remains dark and believable.

[Performance and body physics]
Heroine’s goal is to stop the zombies from crashing into her body and open the front passage. Her eyes lock first on wrist, shoulder, or chest, then head and torso follow. After each hit she confirms target briefly and instantly shifts to the next threat. Natural blinking, small eye adjustments, moist eye reflections. Tight mouth line, slightly tucked jaw, short exhales on strikes. When compressed backward, right shoulder and upper back visibly jolt, brows tighten, one forced inhale escapes. After the second planted step, jaw loosens slightly, weight sinks, gaze narrows onto the worker’s chest and shoulder, then she delivers the warning and attacks immediately.
Combat language: short palm crashes, forearm interceptions, waist-driven sleeve strikes. Force travels from planted foot to knee, hips, waist, shoulder, arm. Contact causes local compression, then immediate release into the next action. No long palm push against the chest. Zombies keep forward inertia after their arms are deflected. Missed attacks need recovery steps and turning. Hit reactions show cloth compression, torso deflection, balance loss, step compensation, pillar impact, water splash. Wide sleeves accelerate from the arm root, sleeve ends lag and whip, then settle. Skirt follows real leg path. Waist ornament and dangling beads swing back briefly and lightly click. The high bun and crown stay firm. Heroine’s chest has only subtle fabric-constrained inertia from breath, sudden stop, waist twist, and impact, quickly fading.

[Magic and environment]
Only one main magic: gold-petal force generated from the embroidered sleeve openings. In close combat, tiny gold fragments cling to the embroidery and flare only at real impact points during sleeve strikes or palm crashes, becoming a few translucent thin foil-like petals that bend under pressure and scatter. When the arm retracts, the glow weakens.
Final strike: petals generate piece by piece from both sleeves and the forward edge of both palms, overlapping into a layered fan with real curvature, thickness, and front-back occlusion. It first hits the worker’s chest and shoulder, then pushes through the passage between the two pumps, spreading wider after clearing the pump fronts to about 6 meters across the forward and front-side space. The petals never pass through pumps or pillars; their edges shatter on contact with solid objects. The impact pushes thin water mist around machine edges. Pressure path must be traceable from source to path to contact to displacement to landing. Heroine stays behind the force, absorbing recoil through waist and legs, never swept away by her own strike. Spent petals break into gold dust and fade inside mist.
Light wind blows in from the road, moving hanging vines, loose hair, hem, and paper scraps. Wet ground responds with splashes, ripples, and landing water bursts. Small dust rises only from dry cracks and base edges. Dry pillar surfaces and canopy fixtures shed dust only after real impact or vibration. Keep silhouettes and contact points readable.

[Sound]
No music, no narration. Continuous wind and weak lamp hum. Zombie sounds are only nonverbal snarls, changing with distance and occlusion. Interceptions are short dry impacts, sleeve strikes are crisp and dense, palm crashes are solid, shoulder collisions are low and heavy, pillar collisions shake the structure, the final magic hit is the heaviest sound. Sound happens only at impact; empty swings are just air cuts. After heavy hits keep breath, recovery steps, skid, and splash sounds.
Heroine is the only speaker. Only line: “Back off.” Adult female, low clear mid register, slight natural Chinese accent, short delivery with active breathing. Speak it at 9.05s-9.65s, stress “Back”, drop “off” cleanly, then release a short exhale into the attack. No subtitles on screen.

Heroine intercepts the side grab with left forearm and braces the worker with right forearm across her chest. His body weight compresses her right arm inward; shoulders and back jolt, left knee bends, left foot forced backward for the first retreat step. Water splashes.

Worker pins the right wrist and shoulder-checks into her tightened right upper arm. Her jaw snaps down, right shoulder is knocked back, right foot retreats for the second forced step. The instant she plants, she sinks, lifts with a short upward right forearm brace, then delivers a tight right palm crash into his chest-shoulder, immediately retracting. Worker folds back and must splash-step to recover. She earns a brief speaking gap.
8.80-10.00: stable right-side low medium-wide. Do not repeat the step landing. Heroine settles into left foot forward, right foot back. She breathes from sharp inhale into supported exhale. Worker steps back in. Her eyes lock onto his chest-shoulder. 9.05-9.65: she says, “Back off.” As she speaks, both palms enter the power path and the sleeve embroidery lights petal by petal.

She drives from the back foot through hips and shoulders into a short double-palm strike. Petal front edge bends under pressure, cloth caves inward, the worker’s forward motion is first stopped then blasted backward, head and arms lag from inertia, heels lift, water droplets keep moving. Minimalism only works when the silhouette is unmistakable before the material effect begins.
🍾 front-facing champagne bottle with rounded shoulders, a narrowing neck, and a readable capsule top before the gold lacquer is added
This keeps the object legible as a bottle, not a flat gold shape. The luxury comes from recognition first, abstraction second.
✨ one thin liquid stream entering from above, several short gravity-led drips on the bottle, and one dominant tail falling into a small reflective pool
The liquid gets a complete physical route: source, coating, descent, and landing. That restraint makes the sculpture feel deliberate rather than randomly melted.

A luxury champagne poster for fictional house MAISON DORIELLE, designed as an ultra-minimal object advertisement where the central form reads clearly as a sculptural champagne bottle rather than a flat label. Preserve the exact visual logic: a pale cool-grey full-bleed studio background, one centered suspended object, a thin vertical stream of dense golden liquid pouring from the top edge into the object, and one long gravity-pulled drip extending downward into a small glossy pool beneath. The bottle is the only visual event in the frame.

Create one iconic champagne-bottle silhouette as the hero object: a compact body with gently rounded shoulders, a narrowing neck, and a softly implied cork or capsule top, front-facing and centered, transformed into an abstract sculptural surface coated in thick luminous golden lacquer. The form should stay stylized and rare, not like a conventional bottle photo, yet read unmistakably as a luxury champagne bottle. The coating wraps the bottle with smooth tension, rounded edges, satin gloss, and controlled viscosity, with several natural drips hanging from the lower body and neck. The liquid behavior is physically convincing: one narrow stream enters from above, the bottle holds mass and surface tension, several drip tails elongate naturally, and one dominant drip falls into a small circular reflective pool.

The bottle should feel like a hybrid of premium packshot and liquid sculpture: molten champagne, liquid gold glaze, and haute couture enamel fused together. Push the shape slightly more volumetric and bottle-like, with subtle shoulder curvature, a readable neck transition, and luxurious mass, while keeping the composition minimal and centered. The golden coating should carry rich membrane quality, slight meniscus edges, deep champagne-amber undertones, and clean controlled reflections, as if the champagne has solidified into its own bottle-icon totem.

Typography is original, elegant, and minimal, integrated directly on the bottle surface. Use refined black or deep charcoal lettering such as “MAISON DORIELLE” as the main mark, with smaller lines like “CHAMPAGNE”, “BRUT”, and “REIMS, FRANCE”. The text should feel like real luxury bottle labeling slightly veiled beneath the glossy liquid skin, still readable but softened by curvature, reflections, and coating thickness. No external headline is needed.

Use a front-facing centered packshot composition with extreme negative space, full-bleed background, and museum-level stillness. 她紧紧握着一根巨大的古代木质部落长矛，竖直置于画面左侧。长矛拥有风化的木质矛杆、皮革绑带、原始雕刻细节，以及一枚古旧的石质与金属矛头。

在她正后方伫立着一头巨型成年北极熊，担任她沉默的守护者。北极熊的头部高出她的肩膀，直视镜头，目光冷静、聪慧而具威慑感。细节自然的白色皮毛、逼真的解剖结构，皮毛上带有积雪与霜冻。

自然北极日光、电影级阴影、冷蓝灰色调、微妙的暖色火光、85mm 镜头、浅景深、逼真的皮肤与皮毛质感、纪实摄影风格、细微的胶片颗粒。

在海报上部显著位置以巨大优雅的高对比度衬线字体呈现目的地名称，让字母与天际线自然交融。选定字母以温暖的赭色/金色点缀强调，其余字体保持深炭黑色。

在字体下方，根据 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 最具辨识度的视觉特征，自动创作一幅内容丰富的全景插画场景。以其最具标志性的地标或建筑元素作为主导焦点，辅以真正属于该目的地的次要建筑、桥梁、街道、滨水区、山脉、纪念碑或文化细节。

在合适的位置加入微妙的复古日盘、富有氛围的云层、远景轮廓以及自然环境细节。整体场景应显得辽阔、优雅、精心构图，避免拥挤。

编辑细节
在字体周围加入小巧精致的目的地信息：
— 地区/州/国家
— 辨识度高的次要地标
— 大致坐标
— 一到两个简短的位置描述词

保持这些细节低调克制，与字体在排版上保持平衡。根据目的地自动确定合适的信息。

视觉风格
中世纪旅行海报 × 雕刻式建筑插画 × 复古编辑设计 × 精致的美国旅游印刷品。

使用精细的墨线与雕刻式线条、细腻的交叉影线、网点印刷质感、略微不完美的套印对准、细微的纸张纹理以及克制的手工印刷瑕疵。

配色方案
温暖的象牙白纸张背景、炭黑色、柔和的建筑灰、淡雅的蓝色或目的地特有的氛围色调，以及一个强烈的赭色/金色点缀。在保留复古印刷美学的同时，根据目的地特质自动调整点缀色。

字体排版
大型优雅的高对比度衬线展示字体、考究的编辑间距、超大字号、克制的次级无衬线或衬线信息字体、强烈的层级感以及充裕的留白。

最终美学
一张高级博物馆商店级别的旅行海报，具有收藏感、永恒性、建筑感、精致感、略带怀旧，并真实呈现于陈年象牙纸上。

避免照片写实、光泽化数字渲染、现代渐变、过度用色、通用地标、杂乱布局、卡通风格、过多文字、标志、水印、UI 元素以及当代广告美学。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized sound. B interrupts spectacular sword combat by capturing Shibuya's giant monster with an enormous arcade claw. Its dangling legs kick helplessly. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice = @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice = @Audio 2.
Monster = @Image 3, approximately 100 meters tall.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Identity references only; no sheet layouts.
One A, one B, one monster. Allied heroines, equal standing height excluding ornaments.
Heroines remain clean-lined, cel-shaded 2D anime. Monster retains its reference style. Shibuya, claw, cable, glass, concrete, dust and reflections are photorealistic. Match scene lighting without changing illustrated faces.
VOICE
ONE spoken line. A uses @Audio 1 at 0.3–1.1s and says:
「いくよ！」
Natural Japanese pronunciation and accurate lip sync. References define voices, not scripts; never replay recordings.
B is silent; @Audio 2 is unused.
After this line: no speech, narration, screams, grunts, gasps, laughter or audible character breaths. Music and effects continue.
LOCATION AND PROPS
Rain-wet nighttime Shibuya crossing: zebra stripes, towers, neon reflections. Screens show abstract colors, no text. No civilians, traffic or extra monsters.
A fights on the near crossing; B stands on the nearby sidewalk. Monster occupies the far side between buildings. Preserve this geography and all damage.
A has one right-hand katana and one waist scabbard. Her blade never changes shape.
B stands behind a plain waist-high arcade pedestal, present from the opening. ONE joystick, ONE red button, no screen or labels. Left hand moves joystick; right index finger presses button.
Claw: one giant silver three-pronged arcade grabber, central housing and ONE taut steel cable extending upward beyond the frame. Rounded gripping ends, consistent mechanical design. Open span exceeds the monster's shoulder width.
CAPTURE RULES
Joystick aligns the claw. ONE button press triggers descent, closure and lifting.
Show the claw approaching OPEN, surrounding the upper torso, making contact, closing beneath the shoulders and THEN lifting.
Three prongs form a supporting cage around the torso without piercing, crushing or passing through it. Head, arms and legs remain visible.
The monster retains its size and design; only the dangling posture resembles a prize. No plush transformation.
Feet leave the road only after the closed claw is pulled upward by its cable. No levitation before gripping.
Once captured, it stays held and continues rising. No release or escape.
Heroines remain outside the debris path and are never captured.
0.0–4.0s — EXPLOSIVE COMBAT
Open immediately: the monster's huge beam cuts across the far road, rupturing asphalt in a traveling line of impacts.
A sprints diagonally clear of the beam, trailing teal light and water spray.
She kicks off a low facade and launches into ONE airborne sword slash.
A speaks the opening line in the specified window.
Her katana releases a broad teal-white crescent that visibly strikes the monster's torso. Brief impact slowdown, sparks and an air ring, then explosive follow-through.
Monster staggers but stays standing. Its beam stops.
A lands at the near crossing and raises her blade for another attack.
Briefly establish B beside her pedestal, calmly watching.
Fast tracking; readable silhouettes.
4.0–6.0s — THE BUTTON
Medium shot includes B's face, hands, joystick and button.
B moves the joystick once with her left hand while looking upward, aligning the claw above the monster.
Her right index finger visibly presses the red button ONCE. Ordinary arcade click; neutral expression.
Cut upward: clouds part around the enormous OPEN claw beginning its vertical descent, cable visible above it.
Button press precedes descent.
6.0–8.5s — THE CLAW DESCENDS
Low three-quarter wide view includes monster, claw and buildings.
The open claw drops between the towers. Air pressure rolls the clouds outward and drives dust along the street.
An outer prong clips an empty building corner, shearing off glass and concrete. Heavy fragments fall away from the heroines.
The claw slows near the monster. Preserve clear body and prong silhouettes.
Open prongs surround the torso, contact its sides and close beneath the shoulders in one readable movement.
A deep mechanical clunk marks the completed grip.
Show closure before lifting, without a cut hiding capture.

8.5–11.0s — AN ENORMOUS PRIZE
Cable retracts, lifting the closed claw. Show both monster feet leaving the street and loose rubble falling beneath them.
The monster hangs upright, supported beneath the shoulders, torso slightly slumped.
Both legs make short, frantic alternating kicks. Arms flail without changing anatomy. Hold a wide view long enough to read the helpless dangling posture.
As it rises, one swinging foot strikes an upper facade and breaks glass and concrete outward. Show foot contact before destruction.
Claw stays closed, cable taut; no shrinking or toy transformation.
Tilt upward with the ascent, preserving the claw and monster outlines against the clouds.
11.0–12.5s — B WINS
Medium two-shot near the crossing: A left, B right beside the pedestal.
Captured monster continues rising in the distant background, legs still kicking.
B releases the controls and gives one small satisfied right-handed fist pump.
A holds her katana ready with nothing left to fight. She looks up after the monster, then toward B. Her determined expression fades.
Keep her blade clear of B and the pedestal.
12.5–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Frontal close-up of A, exact reference face and hairstyle.
Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows; lips part ONCE and hold still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A looks toward camera; no blush, crying or scream face.
Short controlled push-in; hold the final full second with tiny natural movement. Sword outside the crop.
Damaged Shibuya remains blurred behind her. End on A, no extra gag or cut back.
CAMERA AND SOUND
Directional tracking, brief impact slowdown, wide capture framing. Blur backgrounds and debris, preserve silhouettes.
Instrumental percussion, strings and brass; no choir or vocal samples.
Synchronize combat impacts, button, winch, claw and structural damage.
Reduce dramatic music as the claw closes. Stop it when the monster's feet leave the road, revealing machinery, frantic foot impacts and falling rubble.
Final face: faint wind, distant winch and settling debris.
No monster vocals, canned laughter, comedy sting or victory announcement.
EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, score displays, extra characters, clones, mixed identities, costume changes, extra limbs or fingers, fused bodies, morphing weapons, gore, injured heroines, changing claw geometry or monster release.

制作一段15秒的日语动作喜剧片段,带有同步音效。B用一台巨大的街机爪机捕获涉谷的巨型怪兽,从而打断了激烈的剑斗。被悬吊的双腿无助地踢动。结尾以A那张熟悉、沉默、震惊的面孔收尾。使用所选的画面宽高比。

A = 来自@Image 1 的黑发女主角;声音 = @Audio 1。
B = 来自@Image 2 的白发女主角;声音 = @Audio 2。
怪兽 = @Image 3,身高约100米。
保留精确的面孔、发型、服装、配饰、比例及参考美术风格。仅为身份参考,不提供图集版式。
一位A、一位B、一只怪兽。两位女主角为同盟关系,站姿身高相等(配饰除外)。
女主角保持干净的线条、赛璐璐上色的2D动画风格。怪兽保持其参考风格。涉谷、爪机、缆绳、玻璃、混凝土、尘土及反光为照片写实风格。匹配场景光照,不改变绘制的面孔。

仅一句台词。A在0.3–1.1秒使用@Audio 1并说出:

自然的日语发音与准确的口型同步。参考仅定义声音,不定脚本;切勿重放录音。
B保持沉默;@Audio 2 不用。
此句台词之后:无对白、旁白、尖叫、呻吟、喘息、笑声或可听到的角色呼吸。音乐与音效继续。
LOCATION AND PROPS(地点与道具)
雨夜湿润的涉谷十字路口:斑马线、高楼塔楼、霓虹倒影。屏幕显示抽象色彩,无文字。无平民、交通或其他怪兽。
A在近侧十字路口战斗;B站在附近的人行道上。怪兽占据远侧两栋建筑之间的位置。保留此地理关系及所有破坏。

场景：黎明时分，一座规模宏大且现代的马士基物流枢纽。画面前景，一辆崭新的马士基蓝（Maersk Blue）电动集装箱卡车从一座高端物流园区自信地驶向镜头。卡车装载着一个官方马士基海运集装箱，集装箱带有正宗的马士基星形 logo 与企业蓝涂装。车辆以极具张力的前 3/4 视角呈现，成为整幅构图的视觉主角。

其后方，是一座先进、繁忙运转的集装箱码头。巨型岸桥（ship-to-shore）起重机精准地吊运集装箱，自动导引车（AGV）在堆场中有序穿梭，整齐堆叠的马士基集装箱形成强烈的几何节奏。远处，一艘巨型马士基集装箱船停靠在码头，船上装载着数百个集装箱。地平线上方，一架现代货机正爬升入空，完整呈现"从海到空"端到端物流故事。

以人物点缀为 campaign 注入活力：佩戴安全头盔的物流经理在平板电脑上查看作业情况，起重机操作员协调集装箱移动，叉车司机搬运货物，码头工人检查集装箱，所有人物均自然抓拍、不看镜头。每一个动作都真实可信，营造出有生命的工业生态，而非刻意的企业摆拍。

环境干净、精心设计且高端，灵感源自斯堪的纳维亚工业建筑——抛光混凝土、玻璃控制塔、井然有序的集装箱堆场、平静的海面、清澈的蓝天以及若有若无的薄雾。整座物流枢纽显得高效、可持续且技术先进。

构图须大胆且极具图形感。超大白色负空间平衡工业场景。巨幅编辑级排版文字 "MOVE THE WORLD." 与建筑空间融合，部分叠压在集装箱之上，但不得遮挡重要主体。纤细的技术网格线、克制的路线图形、坐标标记以及极简的物流灵感设计元素，强化马士基的工程精度。大型马士基蓝几何色块锚定整体构图，建立现代企业视觉系统而不显杂乱。

色彩搭配：正宗马士基蓝（#42B0D5）、纯净白、柔和混凝土灰、钢灰、深海蓝，并以克制的安全黄作为点缀。斯堪的纳维亚极简风格，对比干净，高端企业美学。

光线：明亮的自然晨光，柔和漫射阳光，金属漆面、海运集装箱、卡车车身与玻璃建筑上的真实反射，清澈的空气纵深，高端商业汽车与工业摄影质感。

拍摄器材参考：Phase One XF IQ4 150MP 中画幅相机 + Schneider Kreuznach 55mm 镜头，超高动态范围，细节锐利分明，逼真的集装箱纹理、钢面、轮胎橡胶、玻璃反光、金属漆面、细微磨损、真实的工业材质、自然的人物皮肤质感以及高端色彩科学。

一张超写实的街拍抓拍照片，画面中是一位年轻成年男子，在温暖的傍晚时分穿行于一个热闹的市中心街区。整张照片应像朋友在城市中闲逛时捕捉到的真实而自然的瞬间，带有一种略带怀旧感的早期数码相机美学。
他留着一头中长度的凌乱深金色头发，自然卷曲，松散地搭在额前。他的五官硬朗而放松，肤色略带古铜色，面部有着细腻自然的肌肤质感。
他微微回头望向镜头，带着一丝含蓄的半笑，仿佛在回应身后发生的某件事。
服装
他穿着一件简单的深炭灰色宽松 T 恤，版型宽松随意。
造型刻意保持极简：
柔软的棉质纹理
略微宽松的袖口
自然的布料褶皱
日常休闲街头风
无可见的品牌标志或图案
低调的男性化穿搭
服装应保持普通而真实，避免时尚大片感。
姿态
他正沿着城市人行道行走，镜头从他稍后方和侧面进行捕捉。
他的躯干背向镜头，但头部转向拍摄者方向。
一只手随意弯曲，抬起做出一个松散的竖起大拇指 / 向后指的手势，仿佛在随意指向街对面某个东西。
他的姿态应显得完全自然、放松。
拍摄者看起来像是走在附近，因此画面带有一丝手持拍摄的不完美构图感。
环境
一个傍晚时分热闹的北美市中心街区。
包含：
宽阔的城市街道
几辆行驶中的汽车
正在穿过十字路口的骑行者
沿街商铺
餐厅和咖啡馆
成熟的行道树
公寓和办公楼
公共交通标识
路牌和电线杆
远处有行人
户外餐厅座位
真实的城市杂物细节
背景应像真实的社区，而非千篇一律的电影化城市布景。
光线
温暖的傍晚阳光从主体侧后方照来。
营造：
发丝上温暖的金色高光
脸颊和下颌线上柔和的日光
头发下方轻柔的阴影
附近车身上温暖的反射光
树木和建筑物下方稍暗的阴影区域
光线应具有自然的琥珀色调，几乎像是在日落前不久拍摄的照片。
摄影风格
真实早期数码相机 / 怀旧街头摄影：
35mm 等效焦距
手持快照
略带不完美的构图
中等景深
真实的背景细节
细微的数码噪点
略微降低的反差
偏暖的色彩基调
轻微的压缩感和类胶片柔和感
自然的皮肤质感
行驶中的骑行者与车辆带有真实动感
照片应像一张真实私人的夏日城市下午快照，而非专业时尚拍摄。
构图
横向 4:3 照片。
将男子明显置于画面右侧，同时在他左侧保留大量城市环境空间。
相机大致位于肩膀高度。
利用街道透视和经过的骑行者作为通向主体的自然引导元素。
背景应保持可辨识且细节丰富，但比前景略柔和。
构图应保留边走边拍的随性感，而非精心布置的人像。
配色
温暖的金色肤色
深金色头发
炭灰色
柔和的绿色树木
混凝土灰
褪色的红色和橙色店面
深色沥青
温暖的琥珀色高光
略微去饱和的城市色彩
整体氛围：休闲、男性化、怀旧、自然随性、都市、夏末午后。

Ultra-realistic candid street photograph of a young adult man walking through a lively downtown neighborhood on a warm late-afternoon day. The photograph should feel like an authentic spontaneous moment captured by a friend while exploring the city, with a slightly nostalgic early-digital-camera aesthetic.
He has medium-length tousled dirty-blonde hair, naturally wavy and swept loosely across his forehead. His features are masculine and relaxed, with lightly tanned skin and subtle natural facial texture.
He looks back toward the camera over his shoulder with a small, understated half-smile, as though reacting to something happening behind him.
Outfit
He wears a simple dark charcoal-gray oversized T-shirt with a relaxed fit.
The styling is deliberately minimal:
soft cotton texture
slightly loose sleeves
natural fabric creases
casual everyday streetwear
no visible logos or graphics
understated masculine styling
Keep the outfit ordinary and believable rather than fashion-editorial.
Pose
He is walking along a city sidewalk, captured from slightly behind and to his side.
His torso is angled away from the camera while he turns his head back toward the photographer.
One arm is bent casually with his hand raised in a loose thumbs-up / pointing-back gesture, as though casually indicating something across the street.
His posture should feel completely spontaneous and relaxed.
The photographer appears to be walking nearby, producing a slightly imperfect handheld composition.
Environment
A lively North American downtown street during late afternoon.
Include:
broad city street
several moving cars
cyclist passing through the intersection
urban storefronts
restaurants and cafés
mature street trees
apartment and office buildings
transit signage
street signs and utility poles
pedestrians in the distance
outdoor restaurant seating
realistic urban clutter
The background should feel like a genuine neighborhood rather than a generic cinematic city set.
Lighting
Warm late-afternoon sunlight coming from the side and slightly behind the subject.
Create:
warm golden highlights across his hair
subtle sunlight on his cheek and jawline
gentle shadows beneath his hair
warm reflections on nearby cars
slightly darker shaded areas beneath trees and buildings
The light should have a natural amber quality, almost like a photograph taken shortly before sunset.
Photography Style
Authentic early-digital / nostalgic street photography:
35mm equivalent lens
handheld snapshot
slightly imperfect framing
moderate depth of field
realistic background detail
subtle digital noise
slightly muted contrast
warm color cast
mild compression and film-like softness
natural skin texture
realistic motion in passing cyclists and vehicles
The image should feel like a real personal photograph from a summer city afternoon, not a professional fashion shoot.
Composition
Horizontal 4:3 photograph.
Place the man prominently on the right side of the frame while leaving substantial city environment visible to his left.
The camera should be approximately at shoulder height.
Use the street perspective and passing cyclist as natural leading elements toward the subject.
Keep the background recognizable and detailed, but slightly softer than the foreground.
The composition should retain the spontaneous feeling of a photograph taken while walking rather than a carefully composed portrait.
Color Palette
warm golden skin tones
dirty-blonde hair
charcoal gray
muted green trees
concrete gray
faded red and orange storefronts
dark asphalt
warm amber highlights
slightly desaturated urban colors
Overall mood: casual, masculine, nostalgic, spontaneous, urban, late-summer afternoon.

A long promenade lined with ornate black streetlamps and wooden benches stretches into the distance, with luminous golden-orange trees dominating the right side and monochrome historic buildings fading into mist on the left, all enriched with metallic splatter, raised palette-knife texture, and reflective highlights.

Environment:
• Night street scene with strong one-point perspective, wide pedestrian walkway receding toward a vanishing point
• Left side features elegant old-world building facades in grayscale, softly veiled by white fog and atmospheric haze
• Right side features a row of vivid autumn trees with dense glowing foliage in orange, amber, and gold
• Black roadway runs alongside the trees, separated from the promenade by a line of lampposts
• Several wooden benches with dark wrought-iron frames are placed along both sides of the walkway
• Small distant human silhouettes appear near the center background, walking away
• Sky is deep black, filled with dense gold splatter, scattered white dots, and a few tiny colored specks
• Avoid modern signage, vehicles, clutter, or any contemporary distractions

Lighting:
• Warm internal glow from the streetlamps, creating soft halos and gentle pools of light
• Trees appear illuminated from within and from above, emphasizing the fiery foliage

• Strong contrast between the luminous gold elements and the dark night sky
• No harsh flash, no blown-out lamp cores, no flat lighting

Materials:
• Thick impasto and palette-knife texture across the entire image surface
• Metallic gold leaf-like splashes and flecks scattered through the sky, trees, and ground
• Glossy black lampposts with subtle reflective sheen
• Benches combine polished wood slats with dark metal frames
• Pavement has sculpted raised white and gray texture with gold leaf fragments scattered across it
• Tree foliage appears layered, cracked, and richly textured like heavy acrylic or mixed media paint

Composition:
• Square format
• Strong central vanishing point with the walkway leading the eye into the far distance
• Large foreground lamppost anchors the right side; another prominent lamppost anchors the left-mid foreground
• Bright golden trees occupy the upper-right half, balancing the darker grayscale buildings on the left
• Benches and lamps repeat rhythmically to enhance depth and perspective

Mood:
Elegant, cinematic, and dreamlike—an opulent autumn night suspended between realism and fine-art fantasy

• 长椅与灯柱有节奏地重复,以强化景深与透视

A maid in Kyoto Animation / Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid illustration style. Soft, organic, expressive, hand drawn aesthetic. Rounded forms, gently tapering limbs, relaxed asymmetry, believable balance, natural shoulder angles, subtle weight shifts. Personality expressed through gesture and silhouette. Clear face with soft cheeks, tapered jawline, expressive eyes, economical nose and mouth. Hair in rounded, flowing clumps with purposeful flyaways. Clean, supple contours with restrained line weight variation. Clothing hangs with convincing weight: broad sagging folds, gentle compression at joints, tension at seams. Harmonious palette, luminous midtones, soft ambient fill, simple cel shadows, subtle blush, sparse highlights. Graphite version: light B 2B pencil, smooth tonal masses, tapered strokes, deepened only at focal overlaps. Avoid rigid anatomy, angular exaggeration, glossy 3D rendering, photorealism, harsh shadows, stippling, hatching, noisy textures.

English video prompt: 

A stunning martial arts action sequence. God-tier animation (sakuga), hand-drawn cel animation shot on twos, with a Harris shutter effect. A solo female character runs toward the camera and unleashes a continuous series of flying kicks, roundhouse kicks, and straight punches, with every strike grazing past the lens. Thick, bold smear frames feel weighty yet vanish in an instant, trailing off elegantly. Fluid, acrobatic choreography. Dynamic camerawork with zooms and whip pans, and quick resets. 仅文生图 —— 仅根据[国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题]独自创意性地生成整幅作品。无需参考图。

核心概念
打造一本精致的视觉日记，将一处真实的目的地场景与一组俏皮的 3×3 插画回忆碎片结合在一起。整幅作品应让人感觉像是一本私人的旅行手册、独立艺术出版物，或一本可收藏的视觉日记。

上半部分
用整个上半部分 50% 的画面，呈现一幅电影感、极具真实感的场景，表现[国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题]。自动选择与该地点关联度最高、最具辨识度的主体、环境、建筑、风景、人物、物件、光线与氛围。

保持场景自然且真实，配以精致的编辑级色彩分级、真实的材质纹理、自然光、微妙胶片质感，以及强烈的摄影构图。

下半部分
将下半部分 50% 的画面用作一块温暖的纸质插画回忆板。提取与上方场景关联度最高、最具辨识度的视觉概念，并将其重新演绎为 9 个简化的图形化回忆单元。

包含以下类型的混合：
• 主体或剪影
• 当地地标或建筑细节
• 交通工具
• 食物或物件
• 植物或自然
• 姿态或人物动作
• 文化细节
• 微小的环境元素
• 情绪或象征性细节

3×3 回忆网格
使用一个松散、隐藏的 3×3 网格来安排这九个元素。网格应引导构图，但不以死板的表格形式出现。

允许每张插画在尺寸、位置、角度和间距上略有差异。整体排列保持有机、俏皮、平衡，并有意呈现一种不完美的感觉。

插画风格
采用稚拙手绘涂鸦插画风格，造型简单而略带笨拙，线条颤抖，笔触粗细不均，轮廓局部留白，边缘粗糙，并保留可见的手作瑕疵。

将细黑墨线与彩色铅笔及蜡笔质感结合，加入小面积平涂色块、零散色粉颗粒、可见的纸张纹理、白色间隙与未填满的着色。

不要在下半部对上半部的场景进行写实再现，而应将其视觉信息压缩为简洁且令人难忘的符号。

排版
在构图顶部附近添加一个受[国家 /城市 / 地点 / 主题]启发的小号手写标题。在底部附近添加一行简短的手写说明文字。

在插画周围可少量点缀装饰元素，如松散的波浪线、星星、圆点、箭头或微小符号。

纸张与构图
使用温暖的米白纸张背景，带有细腻的物理纹理与充足的留白。若出现任何网格痕迹，应让其极度淡雅、像铅笔轻轻勾画，仿佛设计过程中随手绘制。

最终美学
真实旅行摄影 × 稚拙涂鸦插画 × 3×3 回忆集合 × 彩铅质感 × 私人旅行手账 × 当代独立编辑设计。

保持整体松散、可爱、克制、有触感，并高度策展化，而非拥挤。

避免死板的网格、下半部写实插画、照片重复、过度细节、抛光矢量图形、亮面数字艺术、重阴影、渐变、杂乱、过多文字、logo、水印或界面元素。

格式：3:4 竖版，上方摄影场景与下方插画回忆各占严格 50/50。

Seedance 2.5 提示词
制作一段15秒的日本动作喜剧片段,需音画同步。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized sound. Spectacular speed, huge effects, readable collisions. B's spinning kick topples a column of giant monsters through Shibuya like dominoes while A is still charging her ultimate sword attack. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice = @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice = @Audio 2.
All monsters use @Image 3, approximately 100 meters tall.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Identity references only; no sheet layouts.
Exactly ONE A and ONE B, equal standing height excluding ornaments. Replicate ONLY the monster.
Heroines remain clean-lined, cel-shaded 2D anime. Monsters retain their reference style. Photorealistic Shibuya, debris and reflections; scene-matched lighting on illustrated faces.
VOICE
ONE spoken line. A uses @Audio 1 at 0.3–1.1s and says:
「いくよ！」
Natural Japanese pronunciation, accurate lip sync. Audio references define voices, not scripts; never replay recordings.
B is silent; @Audio 2 is unused.
After this line: no dialogue, narration, screams, grunts, gasps, laughter or audible character breaths. Music and effects continue.
GEOGRAPHY
Nighttime Shibuya Scramble Crossing after rain. Zebra stripes, commercial towers, neon reflections. Screens show abstract colors, no readable text. No civilians or traffic.
EIGHT giant monsters advance in ONE straight file along the avenue. All face the heroines. Half-height spacing lets each falling body hit the next.
First monster nearest the crossing; others recede behind it. Establish this immediately.
All falls travel backward along the column, AWAY from the heroines. Both heroines finish on the intact near side of the crossing. Ruins persist.
ACTION RULES
Fast travel, visible contact, a brief impact slowdown, then explosive follow-through.
A's energy is teal-white; B's is violet. Use sharp light trails, air rings, road spray, sparks and heavy debris. Keep faces and body silhouettes readable; never replace them with glowing shapes or duplicate afterimages.
A has one katana and one waist scabbard. B's katana stays sheathed; she attacks with a kick.
A charges but NEVER fires her finisher after the opening slash.
B kicks ONLY the first monster. Every later monster falls ONLY AFTER physical contact from the preceding body. Shock rings emphasize local contact; they do not topple untouched monsters.
No simultaneous group collapse, teleporting enemies or transformation into literal domino tiles. Bodies remain intact; fallen monsters stay down.
0.0–3.0s — WALL LAUNCH AND AIRBORNE SLASH
Begin mid-action. A kicks off a building facade and rockets across the crossing, teal trail behind her and concrete chips bursting from the launch point.
Low tracking reveals the monster column.
The first monster punches. A twists past its fist and delivers ONE huge teal crescent slash against its upper torso.
Show contact, sparks and a pressure ripple. The monster staggers but stays upright; the chain reaction has not begun.
A speaks the opening line in the specified window.
She lands on the near crossing, slides briefly, plants her feet and begins charging her katana. Teal light gathers around the unchanged metal blade.
B prepares to accelerate nearby.
3.0–5.0s — VIOLET DASH AND SPINNING KICK
Track B in a full-body side view.
She accelerates low along the road, violet trail and water spray behind her, then plants one foot and makes a powerful violet-assisted leap toward the first monster's chest.
Show the leap continuously.
ONE controlled spinning kick: torso rotates, one leg extends, the other stays bent.
Her heel visibly strikes the chest around 4.5s. Briefly slow this contact, preserving the foot and target outlines.
A huge violet pressure ring bursts from behind the monster's back; nearby windows shatter. Resume speed as its upper body snaps backward toward the second monster.
It falls into, not over, the column.
B rebounds toward the near crossing. Show her landing near A.
5.0–8.5s — MONSTER-TO-MONSTER COLLISIONS
Side-oblique tracking along the avenue.
The first monster initially tips backward with visible weight. Its upper back strikes the second monster's chest BEFORE the second begins falling.
A local air ring and bass impact punctuate contact. The second hits the third, then the third hits the fourth. Continue sequentially along the column.
Accelerate the pacing after the first clear collision. Track beside the chain, showing each next monster upright before contact.
Falling bodies smash empty buildings beside the road. Facades fracture, steel bends, floors break and asphalt buckles beneath each landing.
Heavy debris bursts outward. Keep body contacts visible above the dust.
Body collisions cause every successive fall.

8.5–11.0s — CITY-SCALE CHAIN REACTION
Rise into a high oblique wide view.
The remaining monsters fall in order. The last crashes down with the largest debris plume through the far buildings.
Entire column defeated; show its continuous destruction path.
Keep the two heroines as separate small silhouettes on the intact near crossing.
A's charging glow stays visible: her unused finisher still builds.
11.0–12.5s — READY TOO LATE
Stable medium two-shot: A left, B right.
A completes her charge and holds a dramatic two-handed sword stance. A towering teal aura rises from the blade, but no attack leaves it.
B calmly brushes her empty hands together once, looking satisfied.
A looks toward the defeated column; her confident expression fades.
The sword stays unchanged inside its huge luminous aura.
Stop the music. Leave the quiet charging hum and distant rubble.
12.5–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Frontal close-up of A, exact reference face and hair.
Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows; lips part ONCE and hold still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
She looks toward camera. No blush, crying or scream face.
A faint teal glow from the still-unused sword lights her face.
Short push-in; hold the final full second. End on A without firing the attack or adding another gag.
SOUND
Instrumental percussion, strings and brass. No choir or vocal samples.
Synchronize every launch, slash, kick and collision.
Brief musical drop before the kick, then a sharp crack and deep bass at contact.
Separate each heavy impact from the following concrete and glass crashes.
Music stops at the final two-shot. End with wind, settling rubble and the awkwardly persistent charging hum.
No laughter, comedy sting or monster vocals.
EXCLUDE

Create a premium 4:5 vertical modernist editorial travel collage for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT
Create a sophisticated modernist collage that translates the visual identity of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] into bold graphic fragments rather than a realistic scene. Automatically determine the most fitting human figure, animal, environment, clothing, cultural details, and atmosphere.

COMPOSITION
Place the main human figure slightly off-center, occupying roughly one-third of the composition, with a smaller animal nearby. Reduce the surrounding environment into a few symbolic flat shapes rather than realistic depth.

Build the composition from bold matte-black rectangles, one dominant destination-inspired geometric shape, horizontal bars, thin rules, cropped blocks, small circles, and restrained typographic micro-marks. Allow selected geometric elements to overlap, crop, or partially mask the figure, animal, and scenery.

SCENERY & FORM
Simplify [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] into 2–5 instantly recognizable visual motifs—architecture, landscape, transportation, vegetation, objects, or cultural details—using clean cutout-like silhouettes and flat graphic fragments.

STYLE
Use warm cream paper as an active background with generous open areas. Combine crisp cut edges, dry ink texture, subtle print grain, slight paper wear, controlled asymmetry, and carefully balanced visual density.

PALETTE
Matte black, warm cream, one dominant color derived from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT], one contrasting accent, and one muted supporting tone. Keep colors flat, sophisticated, and restrained.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Modernist editorial collage × contemporary travel graphic × cut-paper abstraction × restrained surrealism × strong geometric hierarchy × sophisticated negative space.

The result should feel intelligent, artistic, tactile, and collectible, with a strong graphic rhythm rather than a conventional illustration.

Avoid photorealism, realistic atmospheric depth, gradients, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, excessive detail, clutter, generic icons, excessive typography, logos, watermarks, or symmetrical layouts.

FORMAT: 4:5 vertical, single unified modernist composition.

为 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 创作一幅高级感 4:5 竖版现代主义编辑式旅行拼贴画。

仅文生图 —— 完全根据 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 创造性地生成整幅作品。无需参考图片。

核心概念
创作一幅精致的现代主义拼贴画，将 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 的视觉特征转化为大胆的图形碎片，而非写实场景。自动判断最契合的人物形象、动物、环境、服饰、文化细节与氛围。

构图
将主体人物略微偏离中心，占据画面约三分之一的比例，附近安排一个较小的动物。将周围环境简化为几个象征性的扁平形状，而非写实的纵深。

用粗实的哑光黑色矩形、一个由目的地启发的主导几何形状、横向条带、细线、被裁切的小色块、细小的圆形，以及克制的排版微标记构建画面。允许选定的几何元素与人物、动物、景物相互重叠、裁切或局部遮罩。

风景与形态
将 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 简化为 2–5 个一眼可辨的视觉母题——建筑、风景、交通、植被、物品或文化细节——以干净的剪影式轮廓与扁平图形碎片呈现。

风格
以暖米色纸张作为活跃背景，并保留大面积的留白。融合利落的剪裁边缘、干墨肌理、细微的印刷颗粒、轻微的纸面磨损、受控的不对称感，以及精心平衡的视觉密度。

配色
哑光黑、暖米色、一个取自 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 的主色调、一个对比鲜明的点缀色，以及一个低饱和的辅助色。保持色彩扁平、雅致而克制。

最终美学
现代主义编辑式拼贴 × 当代旅行图形 × 剪纸抽象 × 克制超现实 × 强烈的几何层级 × 精致的负空间。

成品应具备知性、艺术感、触感与收藏感，呈现强烈的图形节奏，而非传统的插画效果。

避免：照片级写实、写实的空气透视、渐变、3D 渲染、光泽表面、过度细节、杂乱堆砌、通用图标、过度排版、标志、水印或对称布局。

格式：4:5 竖版，单一统一的现代主义构图。

整体氛围

静谧的城市精致感。

文化真实性。

建筑遗产。

现代编辑式设计。

历史底蕴与现代平面设计的结合。

避免

不要卡通风格。

不要 3D 渲染。

不要光泽写实风格。

不要过度做旧效果。

不要浓重的深褐色调。

不要伪造的护照印章。

不要过度装饰元素。

不要杂乱。

不要巨大无意义的文字。

不要随意使用国旗。

A white dress slumbering amidst the waves

Subject:  
On a sandy beach and turquoise blue wavebreak viewed directly from above, a single young adult woman lies on her back with a white lace dress spread out. Position the figure vertically in the center of the frame, making the dress spreading largely to the left and right like wings and the white wave foam approaching from both sides the main focus.

Slender oval face, bright and smooth skin, naturally thin eyebrows, refined nose, pale rose-colored lips. A side profile facing right with eyes closed, a serene expression as if quietly asleep. Very long wavy hair in deep dark brown spreads richly around the head in a fan shape, especially toward the upper left of the frame, with the outlines of wet, fine curls visible on the sand.

Clothing and Pose:

Lying straight on her back on the sand, both arms quietly crossed over the abdomen, both legs together extended toward the bottom of the frame. Long skirt and tulle spread from the waist to the left and right like enormous wings, with the hem blending into the sea foam.

Background and Light:  
Dry, smooth light brown sand in the upper central part of the frame, transparent turquoise shallows in the lower half. White net-like wave foam approaches diagonally from the left and right sides of the frame, surrounding the central figure and dress to form a large V-shape or wing shape. Bright, soft daylight from above illuminates the entire scene evenly, casting very faint three-dimensional shadows on the figure and lace. The water surface retains the transparency of blue-green and the fine details of white foam.

Deep depth of field focusing on the entire figure, lace, and wave foam.

Photorealistic live-action photo expression with a fantastical quality in high definition. Realistically depict skin, wet wavy hair, delicate floral lace and sheer tulle, sand grains, thin water film, and sea foam of various sizes. Cleanly separate white, sand color, and vivid turquoise, preserving the elegance where the dress and waves merge into the appearance of wings.

Negative:

Smoke rendered as soft diffusion, no hard edges
